C0713.title: Illegal Accounts Using AI to Fabricate and Disseminate False Military-Related Information Penalized
C0713.summary: In June 2026, military authorities, in collaboration with the Cyberspace Administration of China, launched a campaign to address the use of AI to create and spread false military-related information, penalizing a number of illegal accounts. Typical cases involved fabricating false military stories using AI, misleading public perception and damaging the image of the military.

references.title: Typical Cases of Using AI to Generate False Military-Related Information
